sutta: 1.76. The deva asked, "What decays? What does not decay? What is declared the deviant path? What is the impediment to wholesome states? What undergoes destruction night and day? What is the stain of the holy life? What is the bath without water? How many fissures are there in the world wherein the mind does not stand firm? We've come to ask the blessed one this. How are we to understand it?" So, he is asking a few questions. What is the impediment to wholesome state? What are the obstructions to wholesome to wholesome states? How many fissures are there in the world? How many uh cracks gaps are there in the world? Wherein the mind does not stand firm. Then the Buddha replied, "The physical form of mortals decays. The name and clan does not decay. Lust is declared the deviant path. Greed is the impediment to wholesome states. Life undergoes destruction night and day. Women are the stain of the holy life. Here's where menfolk are enmeshed. Austerity and the holy life, that is the bath without water." That's the end. One more. There are six fissures in the world wherein the mind does not stand firm. Laziness and negligence, indolence lack of self-control, drowsiness and lethargy, avoid these fissures completely. So, here the Buddha says the physical form of mortals decay. All beings uh have a body and this body must decay. But the name and the clan does not decay. Lust is the deviant path. It says here greed is the deviant path. Greed the impediment to wholesome states. If you are greedy, uh greedy to satisfy our senses uh that is obstruction to wholesome states. And life undergoes destruction night and day. Because life is impermanent. That is the strongest characteristic of the world, of the life. Anicca, impermanence. Uh life undergoes destruction night and day. Women are the stain of the holy life. Uh so, if a person wants to practice the holy life, the opposite sex uh he has to go far away from the opposite sex. Otherwise, a person cannot practice the holy life. And then austerity and the holy life, that is bath without water. Bath without water means purification without needing water. We clean ourselves without without using water by austerity, ascetic practice and practicing the holy life. Then there are six fissures, uh six cracks in the world which makes the mind unstable. Uh the mind cannot stand firm. Laziness is one. Negligence, carelessness another one. Indolence uh no like no energy to act. Lack of self-control, that means undisciplined. A lot of people don't have discipline. Drowsiness and lethargy feeling sleepy, no energy. Uh so, the Buddha said, "Avoid these completely." We want to progress. These are the six obstructions uh in the spiritual path. Laziness, carelessness indolence no discipline drowsiness, lethargy. The Buddha's advice is very practical.
